structuralChecks.name: Project root and object IDs parse as a property list
All project object references resolve
All referenced source and configuration paths exist
Every app Swift file is included
Source build phase matches app sources exactly
Default Debug and Release have no entitlements or APNs compilation flag
Only APNs-Debug opts into development push
Entitlements contain only ordinary development APNs
Face ID purpose exists and background modes are absent
Signing identifiers are deliberately blank, not invented
NidaaProof-APNs scheme resolves target and configuration
NidaaProof-Local scheme resolves target and configuration
Swift package is local without fetched dependencies
No critical request, continuous audio, calling or torch API is used
Local request is one-shot with system sound
No embedded private credentials or third-party endpoints in app
Mac shell scripts use LF line endings
No previous family name in active proof text
All nine scenarios exist for local, remote and critical separately
No physical result is fabricated
Offline APNs payload behavioral tests pass
Documentation local links resolve

limits: Structural validation is not Swift parsing, compilation, SDK linking or runtime verification. Python checks only the offline payload helper.
